changelog:
v1.36.0 - **Weapon evolutions are now discoverable: clearer level-up card + a dedicated Evolutions guide.** The card preview was a cramped, cryptic one-liner ("Lv.10 + any: A Lv.5 / B Lv.8 / C Lv.3") jammed onto a small choice button. Rewrote `StatFormatter._evolution_preview_line()` into a scannable multi-line block ("→ Evolves into X / Needs Lv.10 + ANY ONE: • drug Lv.5 • borsello Lv.8 • music Lv.3") — the choice buttons already autowrap, so no HUD change was needed, and the literal "Evolves into <name>" token is kept so the existing `test_stat_formatter` stays green. Added a **new "Evolutions" tab to the pause menu** (ESC > Evolutions) via `scripts/ui/EvolutionsTabBuilder.gd` (mirrors the `KeybindsTabBuilder` pattern, wired in `PauseMenu.gd` before the TabContainer re-parent): a title, a plain-language legend, and one row per evolvable weapon (`from → evolves_to` + its drug/borsello/music requirement), grouped Melee/Ranged. Data is enumerated at runtime from the `WeaponConfig` autoload (all 18 recipes), so it can never drift from `weapons_config.json`. New regression `tools/test_evolutions_guide` (asserts 18 recipes, leaf-exclusion, known Coltello/Razzi recipes, Melee-before-Ranged sort, and the multi-line card format) wired into the gate + CI. UI polish (card not clipping, guide readability) is a visual/playtest surface. Design + coverage adversarially verified by a multi-agent pass against the real menu code.
v1.34.0 - **Fix shader warm-up FOR REAL: draw in-frustum (so pipelines compile) but freeze + strip collision (so nothing touches the player).** The off-screen `Y=-1000` warm-up (prior commit) did NOT work — objects must be actually DRAWN on-screen for their render pipeline to compile (off-screen only does a partial precompile), so a cold cache still showed an invisible blue terrain. But the in-frustum version before it spawned live enemies + solid buildings on the player. This commit keeps warm-up instances at the in-frustum spawn position (hidden behind the opaque LoadingPanel) AND neutralizes every one: warmed enemies get `process_mode = DISABLED` (no AI/attacks), and a new `_warmup_disable_collision()` recursively zeroes `collision_layer`/`collision_mask` (and disables `CollisionShape3D`s) on enemies, buildings, props, and VFX — so no warmed object can push, block, or damage the player who spawns at the same spot, while every mesh is still rendered and its pipeline compiled. Props also moved to the in-frustum Y (was `-100`). Result: one launch compiles all pipelines with zero gameplay interference. Gate green (`test_playscene_gen` + `test_garden_cane` run the full warm-up).
v1.33.0 - **Evolution Path Previews — weapon level-up cards now show their evolution recipe.** features.md's "Evolution Path Previews / Guide" item: `StatFormatter.level_up_description()` (`scripts/ui/StatFormatter.gd`) now appends a one-line preview (`"→ Evolves into <name> (Lv.10 + any: <drug> Lv.5 / <borsello> Lv.8 / <music> Lv.3)"`) to any weapon's new-pickup or upgrade card whose `weapons_config.json` entry defines an `"evolution"` block — no new config needed, the recipe was already there and just never surfaced outside the equipped-slot tooltip. Also fixed that pre-existing equipped-slot tooltip (`HUD.gd`, "§5.3" comment) which phrased the recipe as requiring all three supports ("Needs: X + Y + Z") — it actually only needs any ONE of them (`Player._level_up()` PHASE 3's loosened gate) — so both surfaces now state the same, accurate OR recipe. Extended `tools/test_stat_formatter.gd`: narrowed TEST 3's "no progression arrow on new cards" regex to the specific stat-progression patterns it was guarding against (so it doesn't false-positive on the new evolution arrow), and added TEST 3b asserting the preview appears. Gate green.
